newsitem.title: DUBAI: Bahrain's Banoco, India's IOC agree 1997 supplies.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain's Banoco, India's IOC agree 1997 supplies.

text.p: Bahrain National Oil Company (Banoco) will supply India Oil Co (IOC) with just over 1.5 million tonnes of middle distillates under a term contract for 1997, Gulf oil industry sources said on Thursday.
IOC will pay a premium to independent fob Gulf prices for one percent sulphur gas oil and superior kerosene similar to IOC's 1997 terms with Kuwait and Abu Dhabi, the sources said.
Kuwait Petoleum Corp and IOC agreed a premium of around 70 cents per barrel to Middle East quotes for gas oil and 50-55 cents for kerosene.
IOC's volume of middle distillates from Banoco is in line with 1996 contract volumes.
IOC is still in term talks with Saudi Aramco for up to 900,000 tonnes of middle distillates, Gulf traders said.
